description: Update an interview’s name, target_url, research brief, status or usability questionnaire. Only the fields you pass change; pass at least one. To start a round use launch_interview rather than setting status to running.

interview_id.description: Interview UUID, from list_interviews or create_interview.

name.description: New interview name, 1 to 200 characters. Omit to keep the current one.

research_brief.description: New research brief; pass null to clear it, omit to keep the current one.

status.description: New interview status, e.g. "ready" once the guide is built. Omit to keep the current one.

target_url.description: New full URL participants start from, including the scheme. Omit to keep the current one.

usability_scale.description: Standardized usability questionnaire each participant answers after the guide: "umux" (four statements, comparable with SUS), "umux_lite" (two statements) or "none". get_interview_report then returns the round's score and grade. Applies from the next round. Omit to keep the current setting.

name: update_interview

status.description: Interview status: draft, ready, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

usability_scale.description: Usability questionnaire participants answer after the guide: none, umux or umux_lite.

title: Update interview
